item.text: I’m checking the current shape of the entity model first so I can move the location handling into a reusable component without breaking the existing simulation flow. The context types are already unified from the previous pass, so this step is about starting the ECS seam cleanly.

I’ve confirmed the current code still has all movement and death-lifecycle concerns trapped inside `Creature`. I’m introducing a thin component layer rather than just renaming methods, so the location logic can move out cleanly and the rest of the ECS shape has somewhere to grow.

I’m applying the component split now: one generic entity registry plus dedicated spatial and life components. That keeps the current behavior intact while moving the fragile field/location and alive/dead state out of `Creature` itself.
The component classes are in. I’m compiling immediately because this kind of constructor delegation is where any wiring mistakes show up, and I want to catch them before the refactor grows further.

The build is green. I’m doing a final hygiene sweep for any stale display-context references and then I’ll summarize the ECS seam that was added, since the project already had the unified `SimulationContext` from the prior refactor.

The context types were already unified in the prior pass, so there was no remaining `SimulationDisplayContext` to merge. I confirmed there are no stale references left.

I started the ECS transition by extracting the shared entity state into reusable components:

- Added a generic entity base at [Entity.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R007_module_java/Entity.java#L7) with a simple component registry.
- Added a marker interface at [EntityComponent.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R007_module_java/EntityComponent.java#L1) to support component-backed entities.
- Moved field/location tracking into [SpatialComponent.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R007_module_java/SpatialComponent.java#L4).
- Moved alive/dead state into [LifeComponent.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R007_module_java/LifeComponent.java#L4).
- Refactored [Creature.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R007_module_java/Creature.java#L8) to delegate `getLocation`, `setLocation`, `getField`, `isAlive`, and `setDead` to those components.

Result:
- Location tracking is now centralized in one component.
- `Creature` is thinner and closer to an entity shell.
- The codebase now has a real component-based seam for later movement/system extraction.

Verification:
- `javac *.java` passes.

If you want, I can continue this by extracting movement/breeding/infection behavior into systems next, so `Creature` becomes mostly data and delegation.
